name: Scheduled Tasks
description: Scheduled prompts/commands that fire into a reusable CLI session or run a cheap shell check and notify on a notable exit code. Migrated from the aw monolith (src/mcp/tasks.py + tools/agentic_output.py, src/api/task_manager.py + task_scheduler.py + routes/tasks.py, TasksTab.jsx).

skills.description: How to create/edit/run scheduled tasks (terminal CLI prompts or cheap-command-then-notify checks) through aw-app-tasks's /api/apps/tasks/* REST surface.

scheduler_interval_s.description: How often (seconds) the watchdog tick scans for due tasks and fires them. Minimum 1s.

terminals_api_base.description: Base URL of the workspace's own terminals API (core, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9123) used by 'terminal'-type tasks to create/reuse a CLI session and write the prompt into it. Leave unset to disable 'terminal'-type task execution — 'agentic_output' tasks work regardless since they run their command directly.
